privacyPolicy: BALCO Converter respects your privacy. This Privacy Policy explains what information is used when you use the application or visit balkanconverter.com.

BALCO Converter does not require an account. Except for the optional website analytics described below, the developer does not directly collect your name, email address, phone number, precise location, contacts, photos, microphone data, or other personal information during normal use.

Google Analytics for Firebase is used in the Android app only if you explicitly opt in. Analytics is disabled before that choice, rejecting it does not reduce app functionality, and you can enable or disable Usage analytics later in Settings. Android analytics consent is separate from advertising and UMP choices and from website analytics consent.

After opt-in, Firebase may process an app-instance ID; app lifecycle, session and screen activity; standard app, operating-system, device and language context; and coarse geography derived by Google from masked IP addresses. BALCO Converter uses low-cardinality events to understand feature use and improve the app. It does not send entered or converted amounts, currencies or pairs, exchange offers, fees, effective rates, rate dates, loss values, Saved Set names or contents, conversion history, pinned-pair contents, widget currencies or user-entered text to Analytics. The app sets no developer-defined User-ID, and Analytics Advertising ID collection is disabled.

Turning Usage analytics off stops future Android analytics collection and invokes Firebase's local analytics reset behavior. It does not guarantee deletion of data already transmitted or aggregated by Google. Google/Firebase processing and server-side retention depend on their terms and the applicable Firebase and Google Analytics Console settings.

Advertising update for version 1.603: the Android app contains an AdMob banner and an optional rewarded ad for scanner uses. A rewarded ad is shown only after you choose the clearly labeled offer; closing or failing it does not remove normal app access, and 10 bonus scans are added only after the ad SDK confirms the reward. The app stores the remaining bonus-scan balance and a random reward-session identifier locally to prevent duplicate grants. These local values contain no scanned text or image. The app does not use interstitial, rewarded-interstitial, or automatically shown full-screen ads. Advertising and UMP choices remain separate from the optional Firebase Analytics choice.
Local app data and in-app review

Conversion history, Favorites, Saved Sets and their names and currencies, pinned pairs, offline rates and timestamps, widget preferences, theme, sound and other settings, analytics choice, and review eligibility counters and dates are stored in private SharedPreferences on the device. App SharedPreferences are excluded from Android cloud backup and device transfer; they remain until cleared, app data is cleared, or the app is uninstalled. There is no app account or cloud sync. The Google Play In-App Review flow does not give the app a star rating, review text, or confirmation that the review card was shown or a review was submitted.

Depending on the visitor's region and choices, Google may show personalized or non-personalized ads. A visitor can refuse consent or manage individual purposes without losing access to the calculators or other site content.

Exchange rates, historical chart data, and the currency catalog are retrieved from the Frankfurter API, which uses institutional and non-commercial data sources. Frankfurter or its hosting provider may receive network information such as your IP address when processing a request. Requests may include currency codes and, for historical charts, a date range; they do not include an entered amount, Saved Set name, history, locale, or other user-entered text.
BALCO Converter does not use this information to identify or track users.

The app uses Google Mobile Ads to display banner advertising. Depending on your region, consent choices, device settings, and Google's configuration, Google may process information such as advertising identifiers, IP address, device and app information, ad interactions, diagnostics, and consent signals to provide, measure, secure, and personalize or limit ads. Google's User Messaging Platform (UMP) requests and stores applicable consent choices and provides Privacy Options when required.

Your settings, theme, favorites, last-used currency pair, conversion history, cached rates, and cached currency catalog are stored locally in app data and are not sent to the developer. BALCO Converter excludes its local preferences from Android cloud backup and device transfer. Google SDKs may maintain their own local operational and consent state.
Locally stored settings, conversion history, cached rates, and cached currency data remain on your device until you clear them, clear the application's data, or uninstall the application.

Google Play handles the monetary payment for Scanner Unlimited, a one-time non-consumable purchase, not a subscription. BALCO Converter does not receive or store payment-card or bank-account details. To grant, confirm, and restore Unlimited, the app uses the product ID (scanner_unlimited), purchase state, acknowledgement status, and purchase token received through Google Play Billing. The app stores the store-specific Unlimited entitlement locally. Purchase data is exchanged with Google Play; the app does not send it to a developer-operated server, Firebase Analytics, or Google Mobile Ads. If a successful Google Play ownership check no longer reports the purchase, the local entitlement is removed.

Without Unlimited, 5 successful scanner uses are available per local calendar day. A voluntarily viewed rewarded ad adds 10 bonus scans only after the ad SDK confirms the reward. With verified Unlimited, rewarded top-ups are not needed. Unlimited is a one-time purchase, not a subscription. It removes only the scanner limit and does not remove the banner ad.
